name: Open5e
tagline: Open 5e RPG content API for monsters, spells, and SRD material
description: Open5e provides a free, open-content REST API for Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition and related SRD material, including monsters, spells, classes, magic items, and third-party open content. Developers can query structured game data for character builders, encounter tools, and RPG apps without proprietary licensing barriers.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints

use_cases: look up 5e spell details by name
list monsters filtered by challenge rating
fetch magic item stats for inventory tools
search SRD classes and subclasses for character builders
